source_issues.finding: Source says two questions then enumerates three. Retained faithfully.
GloVe quality, lower cost and summed-table gains are broad source claims without a reproduced controlled comparison.
Character fragments need not be morphemes; million-entry ceiling, sensible OOV vectors and universal modern-tokenizer claims omit conditions.
Source prose says counts; implementation uses inverse-distance directed weights. Same-word entries may arise from distinct repeated positions.
Weight increases with x up to one, whereas prose says very frequent pairs are downweighted. Fresh numeric checks independently reproduce the inconsistency.

Fresh finite differences confirm gradient of one-half weighted squared residual with both pre-update vectors. Empty table is allowed; log-zero count produces nonfinite output. No real GloVe benchmark implied.
Printed where set has 13 items; current implementation returns 15, adding <where and where>. Code and example are preserved.
Set-based summed lookup is not complete FastText training. No known fragment returns None; shared fragments alone do not guarantee close vectors, confirmed by an opposite-vector construction.
k+256 assumes complete byte coverage and enough successful merges. Toy starts from characters plus end marker, can stop early and does not return a closed ID vocabulary.
GPT/BERT/T5 merge-count and no-OOV statements conflate BPE, WordPiece, Unigram and SentencePiece. Fresh official tokenizer documentation distinguishes these and the byte-level coverage condition.
GPT2 displayed output not model-run. Ġ is a space-encoding convention, not a universal linguistic boundary.

Four-word document REPL is reproduced; six-word canonical gives a different lowest split. Frequency/order affect merges, zero frequencies are accepted, and unknown Unicode is emitted literally without known-ID validation.
Never swap and still TF-IDF are broad source guidance, not measured task-independent production guarantees.
Vocabulary sizes and refusal rules in the protected prompt are heuristics; no artifact prompt executed.
Fresh Jaccard is 6/36 for playing/played. Source compression task switches reciprocal units and asserts a non-universal asymptote. No Shakespeare download/run.

Canonical runs only n-grams and six-word ten-merge BPE. GloVe document definition checked separately on tiny NumPy data. Original parser has nine empty heading IDs; figure requires separate real-site validation.
